ideas.pitch: Satellite-based agricultural anomaly detection platform that monitors crop health degradation and water stress in real time for regional farming cooperatives.
ideas.problem_statement: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning: Build intelligent applications that improve productivity, automate tasks, support decision-making
ideas.title: AgriSights AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the high-scoring industrial satellite monitoring pattern from GeoNex-ATLAS into an agricultural context, appealing heavily to judges looking for tangible local socioeconomic impact in India.

ideas.pitch: Computer-vision powered physical therapy compliance and posture correction tool using webcam-based pose estimation for home recovery patients.
ideas.problem_statement: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning: Build intelligent applications that improve productivity, automate tasks, support decision-making
ideas.title: PosePulse Clinical
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly borrows the MediaPipe biomechanical analysis framework from CricketVision_AI to solve a healthcare rehabilitation problem, making the technical demonstration instantly compelling to live judges.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered dietary intelligence platform tailored specifically for Indian regional cuisines, parsing meal images to log macro-nutrients and micro-nutrients accurately.
ideas.problem_statement: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning: Build intelligent applications that improve productivity, automate tasks, support decision-making
ideas.title: NutriTrack Local
ideas.why_it_could_win: Takes the winning formula of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant and localizes the dataset and prompt engineering for diverse Indian dishes, solving a glaring gap in existing global health applications.
